title.en: EU approves the world's first comprehensive AI law
title.zhHans: 欧盟通过全球第一部综合性 AI 法律

searchSummary.en: The EU AI Act became law in 2024 — the world’s first comprehensive AI regulation. How Europe’s risk-based framework set global standards for AI governance.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案于 2024 年正式成为法律——全球第一部全面的 AI 监管法规。欧洲的基于风险的框架如何为 AI 治理设定了全球标准。

summary.en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament approved the EU AI Act, the world's first comprehensive legal framework for artificial intelligence. The Act classifies AI systems by risk level (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal), bans certain uses of AI, and imposes transparency and governance requirements on developers. It entered into force on August 1, 2024, with phased implementation through 2026-2027. The law became the global template for AI regulation, influencing legislation in the US, China, and other jurisdictions.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 3 月 13 日，欧洲议会批准了欧盟 AI 法案，全球第一部综合性的 AI 法律框架。该法案按风险级别（不可接受、高风险、有限风险、最低风险）对 AI 系统进行分类，禁止某些 AI 用途，并对开发者施加透明度和治理要求。它于 2024 年 8 月 1 日生效，分阶段实施至 2026-2027 年。该法成为 AI 监管的全球模板，影响了美国、中国及其他司法管辖区的立法。

narrative.en: The EU AI Act was first proposed by the European Commission in April 2021, initially focused on traditional AI systems. The explosive rise of generative AI in 2022-2023 forced a major revision to address foundation models and general-purpose AI. The final text, agreed after marathon trilogue negotiations in December 2023, introduced a two-tier system: rules for all general-purpose AI models (transparency, copyright reporting) and stricter rules for 'systemic risk' models meeting capability thresholds. The vote on March 13 was historic — 523 votes in favor, 46 against. The Act's risk-based approach became the dominant paradigm for AI regulation worldwide. It banned practices like social scoring, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces (with limited exceptions), and manipulative AI systems. High-risk systems, including AI used in critical infrastructure, education, employment, and law enforcement, face mandatory conformity assessments. The EU AI Office was established to enforce the rules. The Act influenced: California's SB 53 (2025), Canada's proposed AIDA, Japan's AI guidelines, and Brazil's AI bill. While criticized by some tech companies as overly restrictive, it represented the first democratic attempt to set boundaries on AI at scale.
narrative.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案最初由欧盟委员会于 2021 年 4 月提出，最初聚焦于传统 AI 系统。2022-2023 年生成式 AI 的爆发式增长迫使该法案进行重大修订以应对基础模型和通用 AI。最终文本在 2023 年 12 月的马拉松式三方谈判后达成一致，引入了两层体系：所有通用 AI 模型的规则（透明度、版权报告）和达到能力阈值的"系统性风险"模型的更严格要求。3 月 13 日的投票具有历史意义——523 票赞成，46 票反对。该法案基于风险的方法成为全球 AI 监管的主导范式。它禁止了社会评分、公共场所实时远程生物识别（有有限例外）和操纵性 AI 系统等实践。高风险系统，包括用于关键基础设施、教育、就业和执法的 AI，需进行强制性合规评估。设立了欧盟 AI 办公室来执行规则。该法案影响了：加州 SB 53（2025 年）、加拿大拟议的 AIDA、日本的 AI 指南和巴西的 AI 法案。虽然被一些科技公司批评为过度限制，但它代表了首次大规模民主尝试为 AI 设定边界。

description.en: First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Risk-based classification became the template for AI laws worldwide. Established governance infrastructure (AI Office, AI Board, Scientific Panel) for enforcing transparency, safety, and fundamental rights protections.
description.zhHans: 全球第一部综合性 AI 监管法规。基于风险的分类成为全球 AI 法律的模板。建立了治理基础设施（AI 办公室、AI 委员会、科学小组）以执行透明度、安全和基本权利保护。

description.en: Critics argued the Act's tiered approach created regulatory fragmentation, imposed compliance costs on startups, and that the risk classification system was difficult to apply to rapidly evolving AI capabilities. Some AI companies threatened to withhold models from the European market.
description.zhHans: 批评者认为该法案的分层方法造成了监管碎片化，给初创企业带来了合规成本，并且风险分类系统难以适用于快速演变的 AI 能力。一些 AI 公司威胁要从欧洲市场撤出模型。

text.en: The European Parliament approved the EU AI Act on March 13, 2024 — the world's first comprehensive legal framework for artificial intelligence.
text.zhHans: 欧洲议会于 2024 年 3 月 13 日批准了欧盟 AI 法案——全球第一部综合性 AI 法律框架。

text.en: The EU AI Act became the global template for AI regulation, influencing legislation in the United States, China, Japan, Canada, and Brazil.
text.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案成为 AI 监管的全球模板，影响了美国、中国、日本、加拿大和巴西的立法。

text.en: Industry groups and some member states warned that the Act's compliance requirements could slow European AI innovation and disadvantage EU companies against US and Chinese competitors.
text.zhHans: 行业团体和一些成员国警告说，该法案的合规要求可能减缓欧洲 AI 创新，使欧盟公司在与美国和中国竞争对手的竞争中处于不利地位。

text.en: First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Risk-based classification became the template for AI laws worldwide. Established governance infrastructure (AI Office, AI Board, Scientific Panel) for enforcing transparency, safety, and fundamental rights protections.
text.zhHans: 全球第一部综合性 AI 监管法规。基于风险的分类成为全球 AI 法律的模板。建立了治理基础设施（AI 办公室、AI 委员会、科学小组）以执行透明度、安全和基本权利保护。

sources.quote: The Artificial Intelligence Act is a European Union regulation concerning artificial intelligence. It was the first comprehensive AI law, passed the European Parliament on 13 March 2024.
The AI Act is the first-ever comprehensive legal framework on AI worldwide.
